shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every evening.
Cooking is a fun activity for me.
Traveling helps me learn about different cultures.
I often listen to music while studying.
Exercise is crucial for maintaining good health.
Watching movies can be a great way to relax.
I love trying new foods from various cuisines.
Taking long walks in nature brings me peace.
Volunteering in the community enriches my life.
Hiking in the mountains is my favorite weekend adventure.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you've had?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you think travel impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: How did you become interested in environmental issues?
Q2: What challenges do you think people face in being eco-friendly?
Q3: Why do you believe environmental awareness is important today?
Q4: What tips would you give others to lead a more sustainable lifestyle?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about hobbies related to the arts.
questions: Q1: What type of art do you enjoy the most and why?
Q2: Have you faced any difficulties pursuing your artistic hobby?
